reason: Both identify the exact same defect: the 7d preset uses daysAgo(7) instead of daysAgo(6), which combined with the inclusive [from,to] SQL window and `to`=today produces an 8-day span rather than the intended 7-day span. Same location, same root cause, same runtime consequence (over-counting one extra day). The reviewer adds supporting detail (contrast with 30d/90d being correctly fixed, and a failing test) but the core mechanism described is identical to the ground truth.
